_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored so your settings never leave your machine. Nothing here is secret - credentials live in .env.
_locations: One entry per ServiceTitan tenant. 'code' is a short id used internally and in the location toggle; keep it short and unique. 'env' is the suffix on that location's .env keys, so env 'SPRINGFIELD' reads SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID_SPRINGFIELD, falling back to the unsuffixed SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID when there is no suffixed one. A SINGLE-location shop can drop 'env' altogether and use the unsuffixed keys for all four credentials: [{ "code": "MAIN", "label": "Main Office" }]. With more than one location each needs its own 'env'. Either way the location toggle hides itself when there is only one.
_window: How far back to pull. Leave operationalStart null to use Jan 1 of the current year. AR reaches back further so the 120+ aging bucket is real rather than truncated at the start of the year.
_departmentMapping: ServiceTitan business-unit names are matched against these keywords, case-insensitive, in the order listed. The FIRST list containing a matching keyword wins, so put the more specific keywords first. Business units matching an 'exclude' keyword are dropped entirely (warehouses and other internal units are not revenue-generating). Anything unmatched lands in 'Other' and is counted in company totals but not shown on the department tabs.
_targets: Shown as target lines on the Service tab. Set to null to hide a target line rather than displaying one nobody agreed to.
_rules: lowTicketThreshold: a completed call billing more than $0 but under this counts as a low ticket. boardDays: the rolling 'on the board' window on the department tabs.
_personAliases: One person can hold several ServiceTitan user records. Records with the SAME name merge on their own - every per-person total is keyed by name. Only declare a duplicate here when the two records carry DIFFERENT names, and only once you have confirmed it really is one person: merging two differently-named records on a guess silently combines two people's numbers. Key is '<location code>:<ServiceTitan user id>', value is the canonical name. Run `servicetitan duplicates` to list likely candidates.
